schema:alternativeHeadline: Scan page 28 of Magpie, no. 16. Vertical strip of three small fashion photographs showing people in casual clothing outdoors. Map locates the Tonky Honker at 14536 Arminta on the south side of Arminta Street, west of Van Nuys Boulevard and east of the San Diego Freeway. Roscoe Boulevard is north; Sherman Way, Victory Boulevard and Ventura Boulevard are south. A Chevy plant is marked east of Van Nuys. Scale arrows indicate one mile between the freeway and Van Nuys along Ventura, and four miles from Ventura to Arminta.
